proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#22

their_evidence: Ascension (S3#22): Fitz and May infiltrate the stolen Zephyr One; Giyera knocks May out, Fitz kills him, frees Daisy and takes a dizzy May with them.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Phil Coulson recruits Fitz and Jemma Simmons to his team, and the young engineer becomes one of his most loyal agents and friends. Fitz builds much of the gear Coulson relies on, like the Night-Night Pistol.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Fitz's team leader and friend, for whom he builds gear.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: One of Coulson's most loyal agents and friends, who builds his gear.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Coulson keeps Fitz on his team despite the brain damage that leaves him withdrawn, and has him working on cloaking for the Bus.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Fitz's director and friend, for whom he builds gear.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: One of Coulson's most loyal agents and friends, who stays at his side.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#10
proposed.text: Coulson follows Fitz through the portal to Maveth. Fitz watches Coulson kill Ward, and the two make it back to Earth together.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Fitz's director and friend, who follows him to Maveth.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: One of Coulson's most loyal agents, who escapes Maveth with him.

their_evidence: Closure/Maveth (S3#9-10): Coulson drops into the castle and through the portal after Ward and Fitz; on Maveth Fitz burns Hive's host while Coulson kills Ward, and they return through the portal together.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#22

stages.on_b_card_about_a: An Inhuman May teams up with to save Skye on the Iliad.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#8
proposed.text: May asks for Lincoln on her extraction team and, on the flight, apologizes to him for the killings Lash committed. Lincoln thanks her for stopping Lash when she did.

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An Inhuman May takes on her team and apologizes to over Lash.

their_evidence: Many Heads, One Tale (S3#8): May requests Campbell for extraction; on the Quinjet she apologizes to him for Lash's killings and he thanks her. Earlier, Chaos Theory (S3#7): May steps between Lash and Lincoln and calms Lash.

stages.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend on Coulson's team.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#11

their_evidence: Brand New Day: Mack and Daisy share a heart-to-heart on the Quinjet about Enoch saying this is the last mission; Mack assures her they will keep in touch, then gives Sousa a big-brother talk on her behalf.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#22
stages.text: Gordon raids the Iliad during Jiaying's attack on S.H.I.E.L.D., while Mack stands guard over the Terrigen crystals. When Gordon asks who he is, Mack answers that he is the guy who kills Gordon.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: An Inhuman raider on the Iliad. Mack calls himself the guy who kills Gordon.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: An agent guarding the Terrigen crystals during the Iliad raid.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#10
proposed.text: A young Gordon brings Jiaying to Mack's team for help and flies with Mack to Afterlife, where Mack takes an I.C.E.R. away from him before Gordon teleports Coulson inside.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A young teleporter who flies with Mack to Afterlife to help Jiaying's people.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The Director who flies Gordon to Afterlife and takes an I.C.E.R. from him.

their_evidence: Stolen: Gordon teleports Jiaying into the Lighthouse meeting Mack assembled; Rodriguez, Mackenzie, Coulson and Gordon take the Quinjet to Afterlife, and Gordon handles an I.C.E.R. before Mackenzie takes it away from him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#6

stages.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend on Coulson's team.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend on Coulson's team.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#1

stages.on_b_card_about_a: Jemma's friend and Director while she searches space for Fitz.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#12
proposed.text: When Nathaniel takes Jemma onto a Chronicom ship, Mack flies after her with Daisy and Sousa and holds the Zephyr until she makes it back aboard.

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Jemma's friend and Director, who flies into space to rescue her.

their_evidence: The End Is at Hand: Mack, Daisy and Sousa dock with the captured Zephyr; Mack plans the rescue of Simmons and Shaw and holds off Chronicoms until Simmons and Shaw reach the Zephyr, then blasts their way out.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#2
stages.text: Mack joins the team while Fitz is struggling after his brain injury, helps him modify the Overkill Device, and becomes his closest friend.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Mack's closest friend, struggling after a brain injury.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Fitz's closest friend, who helps him through his brain injury.

stages.on_a_card_about_b: Mack's closest friend, whom Mack shields from an explosion.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Fitz's closest friend, who shields him from an explosion.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#9

stages.on_b_card_about_a: Fitz's friend, now Director, who rescues him and Jemma from Izel.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#12
proposed.text: Fitz comes through a portal from the Quantum Realm into the speakeasy and is reunited with Mack and the rest of the team.

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fitz's closest friend, there when he comes back through a portal.

their_evidence: The End Is at Hand: the rest of the team, including Mackenzie, arrives at Krazy Kanoe; Simmons's ring opens a Quantum Realm portal and Fitz drops in, reuniting with the team.

stages.on_b_card_about_a: May's friend, now Director. She throws him the sword to finish Sarge.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#13
proposed.text: Mack and May board the Chronicom ship together. Mack carries Kora to the controls, and May uses her empathy to stop the Chronicom attack.

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: May's friend and Director, who raids the Chronicom ship with her.

their_evidence: What We're Fighting For: Mackenzie, Johnson, Coulson and May blow a hole in the Chronicom ship's roof; Mack brings Kora in and May sends the empathy signal that stops the Hunters.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2

stages.on_b_card_about_a: Gonzales' man sent to watch Coulson, who becomes a trusted friend.

stages.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's friend, whom the team votes in as Director.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#13

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's friend, who sends him a rebuilt, flying L.O.L.A.

their_evidence: What We're Fighting For: Mack and Coulson board the Chronicom ship together; one year later Mack asks if Coulson got his package, which holds the key to an upgraded, flying L.O.L.A.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#9

their_evidence: As I Have Always Been: Daisy learns Coulson is also aware of the loop and has been in it longer; together they learn of and remove Simmons's implant, ending the loop.

question: Davis's only appearance in Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7 is an LMD of him (S7#13), and Flint's is the Monolith's recreation of him. Should those count as Davis and Flint appearing in the title at all?
